result.topic_en: Gauss expresses a quotient of theta-type series t as a function of λ and u = λ^α, derives the functional equation f(λ,λu)·f(λ,u)=1, relates dt to du/u and dT via elliptic-type differentials, and computes the T-independent part of an integral giving a logarithm of an infinite product.
result.transcription:
224
Noch zierlicher, setze man
$u = \lambda^{\alpha}$
Es ist dann
$t = \frac{\Sigma\, \lambda^{\frac{1}{8}(4n+1+2\alpha)^2}}{\Sigma\, \lambda^{\frac{1}{8}(4n-1+2\alpha)^2}}$
wo für $n$ alle ganzen Zahlen positiv, negativ und 0 eingeschlossen zu setzen sind
Daraus folgt
$t = f(\lambda, u)$ gesetzt
$f(\lambda, \lambda u)\cdot f(\lambda, u) = 1$
# wo ab $= 2(\mu^{\frac{1}{2}} + \mu^{\frac{9}{2}} + \mu^{\frac{25}{2}} + \ldots)^2$
Die allgemeine Gleichung ist
[-$\frac{dt}{\sqrt{t}\cdot\sqrt{(h+htt)}\cdot\sqrt{(1-\frac{h}{tt})}}$-] $= \frac{du}{u} = \frac{dT}{\sqrt{(TT[-T-] - 4\lambda)}}$
wo $h$ mit $\lambda$ oder $\mu$ durch die Gleichung zusammenhängt
$h = \left(\frac{2\mu + 2\mu^9 + 2\mu^{25} +}{1 + 2\mu^4 + 2\mu^{16} +}\right)^2 = \frac{bb}{aa}$ bedarf Berichtigung
$\frac{dt}{[-\sqrt{(bbtt - aa)}\cdot\sqrt{(aatt+bb)}-]\ \sqrt{(aa+bbtt)}\,\sqrt{(bb - aatt)}} = [-\frac{d\mu}{4\mu}-] = \frac{i\, du}{[-ab-]} = \frac{dT}{\sqrt{(4\lambda - TT)}}$
#
Der Zusammenhang zwischen $t$ und $T$, wenn anstatt $T$ S.176 $T'$ geschrieben $T' = T\{1 + 2\lambda\lambda + \lambda^4 + 2\lambda^6 + 2\lambda^8 \ldots\}$
ist enthalten in
$\log\frac{T}{t} = \frac{1}{2\pi}\int_0^{2\pi}\left(1 - \frac{4\lambda}{1+\lambda\lambda}\cos 2e + \frac{4\lambda\lambda}{1+\lambda^4}\cos 4e - \frac{4\lambda^3}{1+\lambda^6}\cos 6e \ldots\right)\log(u + \lambda u^{-1} - T)\,.\,\partial e$
Der von $T$ unabhängige Theil des Integrals ist
$-\frac{2\lambda\lambda}{1+\lambda\lambda} + \frac{1}{2}\cdot\frac{2\lambda^4}{1+\lambda^4} - \frac{1}{3}\cdot\frac{2\lambda^6}{1+\lambda^6} + \text{etc}$
$= 2\log\left\{\frac{(1-\lambda\lambda)}{(1+\lambda^4)}\frac{(1-\lambda^6)}{1-\lambda^8}\frac{1-\lambda^{10}}{1-\lambda^{12}}\ldots\right\} = 2\log\frac{1}{1+\lambda\lambda+\lambda^6+\lambda^{12}+\lambda^{20}+\lambda^{30}}$

methods.what: Expression of t as a quotient of two theta-type series with u = λ^α
Functional equation of the quotient under u -> λu
Product ab as a squared theta series in μ
Modulus h as squared ratio of theta series in μ
Elliptic differential in t equated to dT/sqrt(4λ-TT)
Normalisation of T by a theta-type series
Summation of T-independent part as logarithm of infinite product / series with triangular exponents
